# Security Checklist: Stage 7 — proScout Hardening

**Purpose**: Validate that the Stage 7 hardening requirements (as scoped in `docs/scout-pro-plan-v2.md` §"المرحلة 7") are complete, unambiguous, consistent with the constitution, and objectively verifiable — before any inventory/test work begins.
**Created**: 2026-08-22
**Feature**: `docs/scout-pro-plan-v2.md` §"المرحلة 7 — التصليب"; governed by `.specify/memory/constitution.md` (Principles II, III, IV, VI, Constraints C-1…C-5)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Endpoint Inventory Requirements (Plan §7.1)

- [ ] CHK001 Is the source of truth for the inventory specified as `Backend/routes/*.js` rather than `openapi.json` alone, matching Principle VI's explicit correction that the spec file has historically undercounted operations by ~22? [Clarity, Constitution Principle VI]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "مسموح / 403 / مسكوب" defined precisely enough to classify an endpoint unambiguously — e.g., does the spec state that "مسكوب" requires the response to differ by scope (not merely return 200) to count as scoped rather than allowed-unfiltered? [Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the requirement state what evidence closes each inventory row (an executed request + asserted status/body, vs. a code-reading judgment)? [Measurability]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the total expected operation count reconciled against the Stage 4/5 inventory (83 operations, `specs/005-proscout-players-write/contracts/endpoint-inventory.md`) so a discrepancy is flagged rather than silently accepted as "new" or "stale"? [Consistency, Traceability]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the two endpoints previously left in neither "allowed" nor "denied" bucket (`GET /ages`, `GET /ages/:id` — unauthenticated, per C-3) given an explicit inventory disposition for Stage 7 rather than re-falling into an undefined third state? [Gap, Constitution C-3]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the requirement specify what "default is deny" means operationally for an endpoint the inventory fails to classify — is an unclassified row itself a checklist failure? [Clarity]

## Negative-Access Requirements: Age Groups / Users / Observers / Evaluations (Plan §7.2)

- [ ] CHK007 Are the exact route paths in scope for "route خاص بالفئات العمرية" enumerated (e.g., does it include `POST/PATCH/DELETE /ages` in addition to the two GET routes already tracked under C-3)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it specified whether the age-group negative tests must additionally assert the *unauthenticated* case (per TODO(AGES_UNAUTHENTICATED_READ)) so the test suite documents rather than silently omits the known gap? [Consistency, Constitution C-3]
- [ ] CHK009 Are "المستخدمين والأوبزيرفرز" routes scoped to the full `userRouter.js` surface (create/update/deactivate/restore/vault) or only the list/detail reads — the plan text does not say? [Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK010 Is `coachEvaluations` / `observerEvaluations` scoped to both read and write routes, and does the requirement name the controller/route files so the inventory and the negative tests can't drift apart? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the requirement state the expected status code per Principle VI (403, or 404 where existence must not be disclosed) per route, rather than leaving "negative test" to default to whatever the implementer picks? [Measurability, Constitution Principle VI]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it specified that a 200-with-empty-body response is explicitly disqualified as proof of denial for these four domains, consistent with Principle I/VI, so a reviewer has a bright line to reject a weak test? [Clarity, Constitution Principle I]
- [ ] CHK013 Are query-param scope-widening attempts (per Principle IV's "أي مدخل من العميل" rule) included as a required negative-test variant for at least one route in each of the four domains, or is this left to the E2E section only? [Coverage, Gap]

## E2E Requirements (Plan §7.3)

- [ ] CHK014 Is "التأكد إن الفئات العمرية مش في القائمة" specified as a DOM/UI assertion, an API-level assertion, or both — Principle I requires the API proof, but the plan's wording alone could be read as UI-only? [Ambiguity, Constitution Principle I]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the set of "direct URL access" targets enumerated (which routes: `/age-groups`, `/users`, `/observers`, others?) rather than left as an open-ended "try some URLs"? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the requirement specify the expected redirect/landing destination for a denied direct-URL attempt, and is that destination tied to the single source of truth (`RoleLandingService`) established in Stage 6 rather than a hardcoded string in the new E2E spec? [Consistency, Traceability]
- [ ] CHK017 Is it specified whether these E2E cases are added to an existing spec file or a new one, and — per the Stage 6 lesson about `role-landing-destinations.spec.ts` duplicating truth across files — does the requirement forbid re-encoding literal role→destination strings here? [Consistency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Are login-success and login-failure preconditions for the proScout E2E fixture specified (which seeded user/credentials), or does the requirement assume a fixture that doesn't yet exist in `e2e/seed.js`? [Assumption, Gap]

## Deny-by-Default for Future Endpoints (Plan §7.4)

- [ ] CHK019 Is "اختبار على مستوى الراوتر" defined precisely — e.g., a test that mounts a synthetic/unlisted route and asserts the role is rejected, vs. a test that merely counts `allowedTo` occurrences? Both satisfy different guarantees and the plan text doesn't pick one. [Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the requirement specify which router-level mechanism this test is meant to validate — the absence of `protect`, the absence of `allowedTo`, or `ownership.js`'s default-deny switch branch — since Principle II names all three as independent layers? [Clarity, Constitution Principle II, §"الطبقات الثلاث الملزمة"]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the acceptance criterion for this item stated as "this test would fail if a future PR added a route without `allowedTo`," i.e. is it framed as a regression guard rather than a one-time inventory check? [Measurability]
- [ ] CHK022 Does the requirement address routes mounted with no `protect` at all (the `GET /ages` shape) — can a router-level test even catch that class, or is this explicitly out of scope and left to C-3's documented gap? [Coverage, Constitution C-3]

## Access-Denial Logging Requirements (Plan §7.5)

- [ ] CHK023 Is "log كل محاولة وصول مرفوضة" (Constitution Principle IV: "معرّف المستخدم، الرول، المسار، ومعرّف المورد المطلوب") cross-referenced here, or does Stage 7 restate its own — potentially inconsistent — set of required log fields? [Consistency, Constitution Principle IV]
- [ ] CHK024 Is "مراجعة logs" specified as a one-time manual audit deliverable, an automated assertion (e.g., a test asserting a log call fired), or both? The plan text ("مراجعة") reads as manual only, which is unusual for a hardening gate. [Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK025 Does the requirement specify where these logs are expected to be found/inspected (structured logger, stdout, a specific module) so "review" is actionable rather than open-ended? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 Is there a defined pass/fail criterion for the log review itself, or does "مراجعة" leave success entirely to reviewer judgment with no documented bar? [Measurability]

## `tests/isolation.test.js` Extension Requirements (Plan §7.6)

- [ ] CHK027 Does the requirement reaffirm the NON-NEGOTIABLE constraint that isolation.test.js's *existing* assertions MUST pass unmodified (Constitution Principle III), and separately scope what "extended to include the new role" means (new describe blocks vs. touching existing ones)? [Consistency, Constitution Principle III]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the set of resources/collections the extension must cover enumerated (players, reports, media, season matches, teams) or left implicit? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 Does the requirement specify that any change to isolation.test.js — even additive — needs the "documented security review" escalation Principle III mandates for modifying its expectations, and does it distinguish "add a block" from "modify an expectation" clearly enough for a reviewer to apply that rule correctly? [Clarity, Constitution Principle III]

## Regression Requirements (Plan §7.7)

- [ ] CHK030 Does "regression كامل على coach و observer و admin" name the specific endpoints Principle III requires (players, players/counts, average-ratings, seasonMatches, dashboard/*) or leave the surface undefined? [Completeness, Constitution Principle III]
- [ ] CHK031 Is "لم يتغير" specified as count-and-content equality (per Principle III's explicit wording) rather than status-code-only equality, for every endpoint in scope? [Measurability, Constitution Principle III]
- [ ] CHK032 Does the requirement call out `maskObservedForCoach` and `maskCoachForObserver` by name as regression targets, consistent with Principle III's explicit mask list, or risk a reviewer overlooking mask-level regressions while chasing endpoint-level ones? [Coverage, Constitution Principle III]

## Ambiguities, Conflicts & Cross-Cutting Gaps

- [ ] CHK033 Does Stage 7 as written resolve or explicitly defer the still-open C-3 gap (`GET /ages` has no `protect` for *any* role) — and if deferred, does the checklist/test output need to say so explicitly (as Stage 3/4 did) so a reader doesn't mistake "proScout denied" for "endpoint secured"? [Conflict, Constitution C-3]
- [ ] CHK034 Given Stage 7 has no preceding `/speckit-specify` → `/speckit-plan` → `/speckit-tasks` cycle (unlike Stages 0–6), is there a documented decision for where its concrete deliverables (endpoint inventory doc, new test files, E2E spec) should live, so they don't scatter across `specs/008-.../` by accident of tooling defaults? [Gap, Traceability]
- [ ] CHK035 Is there a stated interaction between Stage 7's endpoint inventory (item 1) and the two prior partial inventories (Stage 1's 4-endpoint note, Stage 4/5's 83-operation inventory) — does Stage 7 supersede, merge with, or independently duplicate them? [Consistency, Traceability]
